purpose: Binance Square Write-to-Earn creator intelligence for original content improvement

evidence_scope.leaderboard_observation: Prior TinyFish observation for 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-18 recorded 10 creator-level reward rows.
evidence_scope.public_profile_research: Public web-indexed Binance Square profile page for 612 Ceros was readable; direct TinyFish fetches of nine Binance URLs returned bot_blocked.

observed_profile_signals.bio: Crypto strategist | Market signals daily | Trade smart, not emotional.

observed_post_patterns: Posts often use a direct thesis, a bias label, an entry zone, multiple targets, and an invalidation/stop level.
The visible examples explain a small number of timeframe or momentum signals to justify the thesis.
Several visible examples include a chart reference and a question inviting reader response.
The page also shows repeated formulaic phrasing and similar structure across multiple assets; NIC must not copy this wording or reproduce the same template for every post.

Some examples concern assets or moves that may already be extended; NIC must independently check freshness, extension, liquidity, and whether the thesis still has a useful entry rather than imitate the selected asset.
caveats: These are current publicly indexed profile examples, not a verified archive of posts published 2026-10-05 through 2026-10-18.
The profile's follower and like counts are point-in-time visible metrics, not proof of reward causality.
The creator-level leaderboard amount must never be attributed to an individual post without explicit post-level evidence.

profile_fetch_results.next_research_action: Use search-indexed public pages and date-bounded post discovery; store exact post URL, author identity match confidence, publication timestamp, observed engagement, and capture timestamp. Keep unavailable fields null and label period coverage explicitly.

required_pipeline_gates: Do not label creator study coverage FULL_7_AND_14_DAY_PROFILE_COVERAGE unless each leaderboard creator has a verified profile mapping and at least one post query/result for each requested time window, or the report explicitly marks that creator as no matching posts found after a successful search.
Separate profile resolution failures, source access blocks, no matching posts, and successful zero-post searches.
Do not claim NIC has trained or learned from a creator unless a persisted learning artifact is consumed by the content-generation pipeline and the run records that artifact ID/version.
Keep creator reward values at creator-period granularity; never infer per-post payouts from rank, views, likes, or generic creator-level reward totals.
Use the observed patterns as hypotheses for experimentation only; optimize using NIC's own post performance and user-provided reward feedback.
